messages:
alex: Quick sync - spotted a telemetry/console mismatch. When an org-scoped API key is exchanged and a request is made in a project context, the trace UI shows only the project as the effective identity. Hard to map back to originating org for billing/incident triage.
maria: Oof. Can you share repro steps + a minimal header dump so we know where it drops?
alex: Repro steps: 1) create org key; 2) call /v1/exchange -> get project token; 3) call /v1/generate with header `X-Redwood-Proxied-Project: proj-33` (or set via exchange). In the UI request detail you see `effective_project=proj-33` but no `origin_org`. Header dump:```
Authorization: Bearer orgkey-acme-xxxx
X-Redwood-Proxied-Project: proj-33
X-Redwood-Origin: org:acme
X-Request-ID: req-abc123
```
sahil: We do capture X-Redwood-Origin at ingress in raw logs. The indexer canonicalizes identity into a single low-cardinality field `effective_identity` and overwrites origin when project is present. We can add `origin_org` as a separate indexed tag to preserve origin.
kevin: Adding an indexed tag increases write and storage cost in the telemetry pipeline. Also, org names can be sensitive. Need RBAC gating so project viewers don't see other orgs.
maria: UX idea: leave `effective_identity` unchanged to avoid breaking dashboards. Add a small unobtrusive "origin" badge in the request detail pane (visible only to users with `read_org` permission). Also add filter `origin:acme` behind the same RBAC.
lucy: From product: +1 for conservative rollout. We should add an org-admin toggle to opt out of origin propagation if they prefer (privacy/segmentation). Document in changelog.
sahil: Implementation plan: 1) ingress proxy: preserve X-Redwood-Origin into request envelope metadata (no header mutating). 2) telemetry: emit `origin_org` as a low-cardinality string tag; only index forward-going events; historical traces remain in raw logs. 3) console: badge UI + filter + RBAC check. 4) auth: org opt-out enforced at exchange time (strip X-Redwood-Origin if org disabled). Also emit a compact kinesis event for rollups.
kevin: We should consider hashing org identifiers in analytics to avoid PII in metrics while keeping readable names in console for permitted users. Also need cost estimate for the new index + retention impact.
maria: Rollout proposal: feature flag `console.show_origin_in_traces` default OFF. Enable in staging for 2 weeks for eng-platform, collect metrics: percent of traces with origin, filter use, RBAC denial rates. Then enable for internal accounts, then opt-in external customers.
alex: Example compact kinesis event for devs: ```json
{"event_type":"origin_hint","request_id":"req-abc123","origin_org":"acme","effective_project":"proj-33","ts":1828000050}
```
kevin: Make sure events are scrubbed for PII. For analytics, maybe store hashed_org = sha256(org_id) and keep org_name only in console views when allowed.
sahil: Dev ownership: infra/ingress (preserve header + envelope): infra team. Telemetry index mapping + kinesis event: me (eng-ml). Console UI + RBAC gating: eng-platform. Auth/org opt-out toggle: auth team. I'll open mapping PR and share cardinality estimates by EOD.
lucy: I'll draft the customer-facing changelog blurb and the internal rollout checklist (including org-admin opt-out copy).
kevin: Don't forget CI tests ensuring RBAC blocks origin badge for project-level viewers. We need unit + integration tests so we don't leak origin.
deploy-bot: flag `console.show_origin_in_traces` toggled ON for staging by lucy at 2026-03-22T10:12:03Z :white_check_mark:
alex: Thanks team — will watch telemetry over the next two weeks and follow up with PR links. :thumbsup:
maria: Ping me on the UI PR when it's ready for review.
sahil: PRs: telemetry mapping (#3456), kinesis event schema (#3457). Linking once opened.
alex: Closing thread for now, will reopen if infra sees header loss in proxy. :wave:
